posts.name: Medic-Tank
posts.cooked:
The kickstarter update 18 hints that Dr. Blake Washington isn't Ra anymore. While it could be pretty much anybody I'm more inclined to believe it is a character we already saw. It sounds like Ra got a younger more inexperieced hostr but a really motivated one. I used to laugh at how often Thiago theories kept popping up everywhere but it did strike me that since tactics is a few years later he could have had some time to mature a bit and that he could have the brash fiery disposition to face danger and his more cooperative mood with the freedom five could come from finally being able to work with his youth heroes including Legacy.

Feel free to post your own theories and debate on this thread.

posts.cooked:
Well it is pretty clear that the Egyptian relics have have had some physical effects on those who works them, take Shu, Geb, and several others as an example before raising that tomb that whole team were normal humans, now we have a ghost lady and a snake headed guy. So I guess I’m too dismissive I’d the Thiago theory, but whenever he’s used in a theory it just seems like an epileptic tree (he’s the operatives son, he is the new Ra, he takes up the legacy mantle one day although this one makes the most sense because of how he’s dressed in every appearance)

As far as why I think Atum could be the new Ra, they do look rather similar to me, in Egyptian myth Atum and Ra sometimes are merged. And it just makes sense that someone tired to Ra’s storyline would take up his mantle, also shattered timelines set the precedent of a nemesis taking up their enemies mantle a (fright train becoming bunker)

Although this could just be some new guy, or Guise, it’s probably just Guise being Guise.
